partner_result_applied.scope: physical 3x3 two-same-sign density theorem and exact M0+M1+M2+M3=e3(A^2) overlap bookkeeping

new_result.statement: For A_M=I-(M+1)vv^T-(3/2)ww^T with v=(1,1,1,1)/2, w=(1,1,-1,-1)/2 and M>1, spec(A_M)={1,1,-1/2,-M}; every physical pair is indefinite; every principal triple has sigma_min=rho_M<=1/(6M-1) while determinant=-1/8; M3=1/16 and M2=3(8M^2+1)/16, so M2/e3(A_M^2)->1. Thus arbitrary one-direction spectral growth can force certificate switching into the overlap-two channel.

unresolved_implication: Give a source-valid aggregate analytic payment for overlap-two minor mass M2 before reciprocal local minor/pivot costs; the A_M family is the required arbitrary-spike stress test.
